description: This Java class, FrameImage, manages image processing tasks for product frames within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for adding images with frames, uploading frame images, previewing combined images, selecting frames, and deleting temporary preview images, integrating with OFBiz services and file utilities.

classes.name: FrameImage
classes.description: A utility class for managing product frame images, including adding, uploading, previewing, selecting, and deleting frame images, with image processing functionalities.

methods.name: addImageFrame
methods.description: Creates a composite image by overlaying a frame over a product image, generating and linking content records, and establishing associations between main and thumbnail images within OFBiz.

methods.name: combineBufferedImage
methods.description: Combines two images by overlaying one onto the other with transparency, returning the resulting BufferedImage.

methods.name: uploadFrame
methods.description: Handles uploading a frame image, saving it to the server, creating associated data resource and content records in OFBiz.

methods.name: previewFrameImage
methods.description: Generates a preview of the product image with a frame overlay, saving it temporarily for display.

methods.name: chooseFrameImage
methods.description: Sets the selected frame image identifiers into session attributes after validation.

methods.name: deleteFrameImage
methods.description: Deletes the temporary preview image file from the server.
